title: Structure view tabs; edit form without Paps/Owner
summary: Reorganized the structure detail page into three tabs; removed Paps/Owner from structure edit (owner_id preserved on update); add-structure flow unchanged; plus optional Playwright E2E database seeding via globalSetup.

items: Added nav-tabs with three panes: tagging fields and images, linked PAPS tables, other_details under Detailed Measurements
Fixed column layout so the image modal stays inside the main column before the history sidebar
Clicks Paps information tab and scopes assertions to #structureViewPanePaps
Edit form: removed Paps/Owner select; added short help text linking to structure view Paps tab
update(): owner_id taken from existing structure row, not POST
Select2 for owner only when #ownerSelect exists (add form)
Documented tabbed structure view; web update preserves owner_id; API multipart update still may send owner_id
Added optional Playwright globalSetup seeding hook (enabled with E2E_DB_SEED=1) that runs truncate_fresh_install + grievance options seed + projects/users seed + profile seed
Added npm scripts test:e2e:seed and test:e2e:seed:headed for local seeded E2E runs
Documented E2E seeding environment variables including E2E_SEED_PROFILES
Aligned test profile-create fixture with current required form validation by selecting project/barangay and filling age, birthday, invitation date, and contact person before submit
Verified seeded headed run now passes the soft-delete flow end-to-end
Added a full headed Structure workflow E2E test covering structure list details expansion, profile quick-view modal, view tabs, edit/save, and delete/restore states
